title: Cancer and industrial activities in China
Environmental Citizen Complaints
The effect of compliance assistance on pollution discharges and violations of environmental regulations
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
abstract: Researchers and policymakers assert competing behavioral models of polluters. One model portrays polluters as best approximated by the perfectly informed, rational actor from economics textbooks. Another model portrays polluters, particularly small and medium facilities, as imperfectly informed, cognitively bounded, pro‐social actors. If this second model is more accurate, environmental programs that offer low‐cost technical assistance may be especially effective in promoting regulatory compliance. Yet the empirical evidence for the effectiveness of such compliance assistance is scant. In a pre‐registered analysis using panel data research designs, we exploit idiosyncratic program roll‐out to estimate the effects of a compliance assistance program that was delivered to hundreds of Ohio water polluters. Although the program was initially deemed a success by federal and state environmental protection agencies, we estimate that, if the program had any effect on polluter behaviors, those effects were small. In our preferred specification, we estimate a precise zero effect of compliance assistance on environmental compliance and pollution. The lack of evidence for behavioral impacts from compliance assistance does not imply such programs cannot be effective, but it does underscore the need for more deliberate evaluation designs when state and federal agencies roll out their compliance assistance interventions.
abstract_zh: 研究人员和政策制定者对排污者的行为提出了相互竞争的模型。一种模型将排污者描述为最接近教科书中信息完全、理性的经济行为人。另一种模型则将排污者，尤其是中小型设施，描述为信息不完全、认知有限、具有亲社会倾向的行为人。如果第二种模型更为准确，那么提供低成本技术援助的环境项目，可能在促进监管合规方面特别有效。然而，关于此类合规援助有效性的实证证据十分匮乏。在一项预先注册的分析中，我们利用面板数据研究设计，借助项目推行中的特异性，估计了一项合规援助项目的效果，该项目曾面向俄亥俄州数百家水污染排放者提供服务。尽管该项目最初被联邦和州环保机构认定为成功，但我们估计，即使该项目对排污者的行为产生了某些影响，这些影响也很小。在我们偏好的设定下，我们估计合规援助对环境合规和污染的影响精确为零。缺乏合规援助行为影响的证据，并不意味着此类项目无法发挥作用，但它确实凸显了州和联邦机构在推出合规援助干预措施时，需要更加审慎的评估设计。

title: Hurricanes and Gasoline Price Gouging
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Conventional wisdom suggests that gasoline price gouging before and after natural disasters is widespread. To explore this conjecture, we compile data on more than 4.7 million daily station-level retail gasoline prices. We combine these data with information on wholesale rack prices, spot prices, hurricane threats and landfalls, weather, traffic, and power outages. We investigate the effect of hurricanes on retail prices, wholesale prices, retailer margins, fuel price pass-through, and share of stations reporting transactions. We exploit the fact that the exact timing and location of hurricane landfalls is conditionally exogenous for identification. We find no evidence for widespread price gouging. Instead, we document evidence consistent with shortages predicted by theory in the presence of restrictions on price movements.
abstract_zh: 传统观点认为，自然灾害前后的汽油价格哄抬十分普遍。为检验这一猜想，我们汇编了超过470万条每日加油站层面的零售汽油价格数据。我们将这些数据与批发油库价格、现货价格、飓风威胁与登陆情况、天气、交通以及停电信息相结合。我们考察了飓风对零售价格、批发价格、零售商利润率、燃料价格传导以及报告交易的加油站比例的影响。我们利用飓风登陆的确切时间和地点在条件上外生这一事实进行识别。我们没有发现普遍哄抬价格的证据。相反，我们记录到的证据与理论在价格变动受限情况下所预测的短缺现象相一致。

title: New water rule turns a blind eye to transboundary pollution: We can’t presume that states will fill gaps in federal oversight
Why are Pollution Damages Lower in Developed Countries? Insights from High-Income, High-Particulate Matter Hong Kong
abstract: Conventional wisdom suggests that marginal damages from particulate matter pollution are high in less-developed countries because they are highly polluted. Using administrative data on the universe of births and deaths, we explore birthweight and mortality effects of gestational particulate matter exposure in high-pollution yet high-income Hong Kong. The marginal effects of particulates on birthweight are large but we fail to detect an effect on neonatal mortality. We interpret our stark mortality results in a comparative analysis of pollution-mortality relationships across studies. We provide early evidence that marginal mortality damages from pollution are high in less-developed countries because they are less developed, not because they are more polluted.
abstract_zh: 传统观点认为，发展中国家颗粒物污染的边际损害较高，是因为这些国家污染严重。利用覆盖全部出生与死亡人口的行政数据，我们在污染严重但属于高收入地区的香港考察了孕期颗粒物暴露对出生体重和死亡率的影响。颗粒物对出生体重的边际效应较大，但我们未能检测到其对新生儿死亡率的影响。我们在对各研究中污染与死亡率关系进行比较分析的基础上，解释了我们这一鲜明的死亡率结果。我们提供了初步证据，表明发展中国家污染的边际死亡损害较高，是因为它们发展程度较低，而并非因为它们污染更为严重。

title: Environmental Enforcement and Compliance: Lessons from Pollution, Safety, and Tax Settings
abstract: Environmental monitoring and enforcement are controversial and incompletely understood. This survey reviews what we do and do not know about the overall effectiveness, as well as the cost effectiveness, of pollution monitoring and enforcement. We ask five key questions: what do environmental monitoring and enforcement actionslook like in the real world? How do we assess environmental compliance and deterrence? Do environmental monitoring and enforcement actions get results? How, why, and when do inspections and sanctions achieve compliance and reduce pollution? And, what do the answers to the preceding questions tell us about designing and implementing more effective and more cost effective public policies for the environment? A key contribution is drawing lessons from diverse sources, including insights from theoretical, empirical, and experimental contributions in environmental, tax, and safety settings. We conclude that traditional environmental monitoring and enforcement actions generate important deterrence effects. However, there are limits to such deterrence, and deterrence itself cannot fully explain all patterns of environmental behavior. Encouraging compliance requires both traditional tools and additional tools.
abstract_zh: 环境监测与执法存在争议，人们对其认识也不完整。本综述回顾了我们对污染监测与执法的整体有效性以及成本效果所知与未知的内容。我们提出了五个关键问题：现实世界中的环境监测与执法行动是什么样子的？我们如何评估环境合规与威慑效果？环境监测与执法行动是否取得了成效？检查与制裁如何、为何以及在何时促成合规并减少污染？以及上述问题的答案对于设计和实施更有效、成本效果更高的环境公共政策有何启示？一项关键贡献在于，本文从多种来源汲取经验，包括环境、税收和安全领域的理论、实证及实验研究所提供的洞见。我们的结论是，传统的环境监测与执法行动产生了重要的威慑效应。然而，这种威慑存在局限，且威慑本身无法完全解释所有的环境行为模式。鼓励合规既需要传统工具，也需要其他额外的工具。

title: The Economics of Environmental Monitoring and Enforcement: A Review
abstract: Without monitoring and enforcement, environmental laws are largely nonbinding guidance. Although economists and philosophers have thought seriously about the broader public enforcement of law since at least the eighteenth century, environmental monitoring and enforcement remain both understudied and controversial. This article reviews what we do and do not know about the subject. I review common environmental enforcement institutions, prescriptive and descriptive theories, empirical evidence on regulator behavior, and empirical evidence on deterrence effects.
abstract_zh: 若缺乏监测与执法，环境法律在很大程度上只是不具约束力的指导。尽管至少自十八世纪以来，经济学家和哲学家就已认真思考过更广泛的公共法律执行问题，但环境监测与执法仍然研究不足且存在争议。本文回顾了我们对该主题所知与未知的内容。我回顾了常见的环境执法机构、规范性与描述性理论、关于监管者行为的实证证据，以及关于威慑效应的实证证据。

title: Absolute Humidity, Temperature, and Influenza Mortality: 30 Years of County-Level Evidence from the United States
abstract: Recent research exploring associations between environmental factors and influenza outcomes has devoted substantial attention to the role of absolute humidity. However, the existing literature provides very little quantitative epidemiologic evidence on the relations between absolute humidity and other weather variables and influenza outcomes in human populations. In the present study, the authors helped fill this gap by analyzing longitudinal weather and influenza mortality data, observed every month between January 1973 and December 2002, for each of 359 urban US counties. A flexible regression model was used to simultaneously explore fully nonlinear relations between absolute humidity and influenza outcomes and temperature and influenza outcomes. Results indicated that absolute humidity was an especially critical determinant of observed human influenza mortality, even after controlling for temperature. There were important nonlinear relations; humidity levels below approximately 6 g of water vapor per kilogram of air were associated with increases in influenza mortality. Model predictions suggested that approximately half of the average seasonal differences in US influenza mortality can be explained by seasonal differences in absolute humidity alone. Temperature modestly influenced influenza mortality as well, although results were less robust.
abstract_zh: 近期探讨环境因素与流感结局之间关联的研究，对绝对湿度的作用给予了大量关注。然而，现有文献几乎没有提供关于绝对湿度及其他天气变量与人群流感结局之间关系的定量流行病学证据。在本研究中，作者通过分析1973年1月至2002年12月期间，美国359个城市县每月观测的纵向天气与流感死亡数据，填补了这一空白。我们采用灵活的回归模型，同时考察绝对湿度与流感结局、以及温度与流感结局之间的完全非线性关系。结果表明，即使在控制温度之后，绝对湿度仍是观测到的人群流感死亡的一个尤为关键的决定因素。两者之间存在重要的非线性关系：空气中水蒸气含量低于约每千克空气6克时，与流感死亡增加相关。模型预测表明，美国流感死亡平均季节性差异中，约一半仅由绝对湿度的季节性差异即可解释。温度对流感死亡也有一定影响，但结果的稳健性较弱。

title: Economic Perspectives on Corporate Social Responsibility
School Buses, Diesel Emissions, and Respiratory Health
The Effectiveness of Environmental Monitoring and Enforcement: A Review of the Empirical Evidence
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Regulatory punishment for pollution violations is a mainstay of nearly every industrialized nation's environmental policy. This article reviews the existing empirical evidence on the impacts of environmental monitoring and enforcement actions. We first provide context by investigating the U.S. regulatory setting. We then briefly discuss how economists think about environmental enforcement. We next consider recent empirical evidence linking regulator actions to subsequent pollution discharges and compliance behavior. Since the literature primarily studies U.S. institutions, our review focuses mainly on the effects of Environmental Protection Agency and U.S. state activities. The consistent findings from this literature review are as follows: (1) environmental monitoring and enforcement activities generate substantial specific deterrence, reducing future violations at the targeted firm; (2) environmental monitoring and enforcement activities generate substantial general deterrence, reducing future violations at facilities other than the targeted one; and (3) environmental monitoring and enforcement activities generate not only reductions in violations but also significant reductions in emissions. We conclude by discussing policy implications and identifying gaps in the current state of knowledge.
abstract_zh: 对污染违规行为的监管处罚，是几乎所有工业化国家环境政策的支柱。本文回顾了关于环境监测与执法行动影响的现有实证证据。我们首先通过考察美国的监管背景提供相关语境，然后简要讨论经济学家如何看待环境执法。接着，我们考察了将监管者行动与随后的污染排放及合规行为相联系的近期实证证据。由于现有文献主要研究美国的制度，我们的综述主要聚焦于美国环境保护署及美国各州活动的效果。该文献综述得出的一致发现如下：(1) 环境监测与执法活动产生了显著的特定威慑效应，减少了目标企业未来的违规行为；(2) 环境监测与执法活动产生了显著的一般威慑效应，减少了目标设施之外其他设施的未来违规行为；(3) 环境监测与执法活动不仅减少了违规行为，还显著降低了排放量。最后，我们讨论了政策含义，并指出了当前知识状况中的空白。

title: The Impact of Climate Change Information: New Evidence from the Stock Market
venue: B.E. Journal of Economic Analysis and Policy
abstract: On June 19, 2007, a non-profit organization released ratings of companies plans for measuring, reporting, and reducing their greenhouse gas emissions. We explore the capital market impacts of this information event. In contrast to much of the related literature, our study examines climate change information and a plausibly exogenous event. We find that the information had an economically important and statistically significant impact on capital market returns. Poorly rated firms suffered market penalties. In contrast, we find limited benefits for firms receiving good ratings. We also uncover suggestive evidence that the economic mechanism driving our results is not a direct consumer demand effect.
abstract_zh: 2007年6月19日，一家非营利组织发布了对公司测量、报告和减少温室气体排放计划的评级。我们探讨了这一信息事件对资本市场的影响。与许多相关文献不同，本研究考察的是气候变化信息以及一个看似外生的事件。我们发现，该信息对资本市场收益产生了经济上重要且具有统计显著性的影响。评级较差的企业遭受了市场惩罚。相比之下，我们发现获得良好评级的企业所获益处有限。我们还发现了一些暗示性证据，表明驱动我们结果的经济机制并非直接的消费者需求效应。

title: Curbside Recycling in the Presence of Alternatives
abstract: We measure the extent to which curbside access affects quantity recycled. We use novel data to distinguish between new recycling and material diverted from other recycling modes. We find that the marginal impact of expanding curbside programs on total recycled quantities is small, in part because curbside programs significantly cannibalize returns from drop‐off recycling centers. Failure to account for cannibalization from other modes may substantially overestimate the benefits of curbside programs. We conclude with simple cost‐effectiveness comparisons. Results suggest that incremental expansion of curbside access may not be cost‐effective. (JEL Q53, Q58, H72)
abstract_zh: 我们度量了路边回收服务的可获得性在多大程度上影响回收量。我们利用新颖的数据，区分新增回收量与从其他回收方式中转移而来的材料。我们发现，扩大路边回收计划对总回收量的边际影响很小，部分原因在于路边回收计划显著地侵蚀了投递式回收中心的回收量。若未考虑来自其他回收方式的侵蚀效应，可能会大大高估路边回收计划的效益。最后，我们进行了简单的成本效果比较。结果表明，逐步扩大路边回收服务的覆盖范围可能并不具备成本效果。（JEL Q53, Q58, H72）

title: Regulator Reputation, Enforcement, and Environmental Compliance
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper explores empirically the impact of enforcement efforts on environmental compliance, focusing on the role of regulator reputation spillover effects. We find that, on the margin, the impact of a fine for water pollutant violations is about a two-thirds reduction in the statewide violation rate in the year following a fine. This large result obtains through the regulator’s enhanced reputation; the deterrence impact on other plants in a state is almost as strong as the impact on the sanctioned plant. Focusing only on the response of the sanctioned plant, as in previous studies, may therefore seriously underestimate the efficacy of fines and other sanctions. This paper also examines the relative effectiveness of monitoring and enforcement instruments. Non-monetary sanctions contribute no detected impact on compliance, and the marginal fine induces substantially greater compliance than the marginal inspection.
abstract_zh: 本文以实证方法探讨执法努力对环境合规的影响，重点关注监管者声誉溢出效应的作用。我们发现，在边际上，对水污染物违规行为的罚款，在罚款后一年内可使全州的违规率下降约三分之二。这一显著结果是通过监管者声誉的增强实现的；对州内其他工厂的威慑效应几乎与对受罚工厂的影响一样强。因此，如以往研究那样仅关注受罚工厂的反应，可能严重低估罚款及其他制裁措施的效力。本文还考察了监测与执法工具的相对有效性。非货币制裁未能检测到对合规的影响，而边际罚款所引致的合规程度则远高于边际检查。
